0022600163.text: The Chicago Bulls (1-4, 12th in the East) visit the Philadelphia 76ers (4-1, 1st in the Atlantic), with Chicago on a three-game losing streak and 1-2 on the road. Chicago is without Dailyn Swain (back soreness) and Nic Claxton (hamstring), while Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (back fracture), and Tacko Fall (quadriceps strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Bulls won their 2025-26 season series 2-1, though they lost 157-137 in Philadelphia in their last meeting on March 25, 2026.
